pronunciation_protocol: Uppercase ALIUS / A.L.I.U.S. is normalized to lowercase alius for spoken rendering.

asr_spotcheck.notes: ASR did not detect spoken speaker labels. The lowercase alius pronunciation was recognized as Elias, not as A L I U S spelling.
asr_spotcheck.excerpt:
Dr. Madelina Kanna is a postdoctoral researcher at Northwestern University and Dr. Rebecca
Seligman is an associate professor of anthropology at Northwestern University.
You are both part of the Elias Research Group devoted to fostering interdisciplinary research
about the diversity of consciousness.
What types of consciousness phenomena have you been primarily interested in?
Could you illustrate how transcultural research has helped you better understand some aspects
of consciousness?
We both conducted our PhD research on spirit possession, Madelina Kanna on demonic
possession in Nicaragua, and Rebecca Seligman on religious possession in Brazilian,
Kingdom LA.
Spirit possession has been frequently exoticized as something exclusively bounded to
localized systems of beliefs.
Also, it has been medicalized and conflated with a wide array of psychiatric constructs
from hysteria to conversion
